name: The Old Summer Palace
description: The Old Summer Palace is a large-scale royal garden in the Qing Dynasty. It is known as the model of gardening art and the "Garden of Ten Thousand Gardens". It was once famous for its large geographical scale, outstanding construction skills, exquisite architectural scenery, rich cultural collections and profound national cultural connotations. Pinku brings together Chinese and Western art, recreating stunning historical works, with gold and silver intertwined, ink blue as the finishing touch, taking a corner of the water method, carving hunting dogs chasing deer, showing a majestic and majestic momentum, showing the style of a royal palace.
